text: MIPVU labels a word metaphor-related when its contextual meaning contrasts with a more basic meaning and can be understood by comparison with it. It is a per-lexical-unit procedure; two colliding domains would be found only by labelling each word separately and then comparing their source domains. (medium confidence)
keywords: Metaphor collision as a detection signal

text: Incongruity-based metaphor detection is invalid for conventional metaphors, because the surrounding context is usual for the target word. A collision signal is therefore strongest for novel or freshly chosen figures and weak for dead ones. (medium confidence)
keywords: Metaphor collision as a detection signal

text: Cross-dataset evaluation finds LLM metaphor detection tracks lexical overlap and sentence length, and accuracy on literal paraphrases often drops or paraphrases keep the metaphor. An LLM-based collision detector should not be trusted without a check against a source-domain lexicon. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-07-21)
keywords: Metaphor collision as a detection signal
